Grace is reading a book about music. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. Grace bought a hat at the shop yesterday. The website has a short video about the book.
Mia is interested in reading. There are always many people at the planetarium hall. It takes twenty minutes to get to the telescope by bike. He grudgingly admitted that his sister was right.
Grace hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Last Tuesday, Grace and Mia went to the telescope. The weather was sunny that day. Best of all, the curvature of the earth makes distant ships disappear.
Grace usually has salad for breakfast. Grace thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Life is full of small surprises.
